name: youtube-agent
description: Eleven upstream YouTube skills plus yt-caliks, the Caliks Art Academy entry point for SEO, packaging, Shorts, scripts, planning, research, retention, editing, comments, chapters, and audits.

interface.longDescription: Use yt-caliks as the Caliks Art Academy entry point: it reads the channel profile and routes to the right upstream skill. All eleven upstream yt-* skills remain available for scripts, packaging, research, retention, editing, planning, comments, SEO, chapters, Shorts, and audits. Includes six local Python helpers. You review the output and publish it yourself.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn a video idea into a script, title, and thumbnail brief.
Analyze my transcript and retention export, then suggest the biggest improvement.
Plan my next week of YouTube uploads around the time and footage I have.
